markdown:
<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 17"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[True Senses](/Feats.aspx?ID=5321) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Awakened Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=787" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 27

**Frequency**
once per day

**Prerequisites**
[Natural Senses](/Feats.aspx?ID=5302)

</column>

---

Your senses are so sharp they pierce through all illusions. You can heighten your senses to non-magically gain the effects of a 6th-rank [_truesight_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1727) spell for 10 minutes. The ability to “see through” [illusions](/Traits.aspx?ID=629) and [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=670) effects applies to any [precise sense](/Rules.aspx?ID=411) you possess.
name: True Senses
